newsitem.title: FINLAND: ASKO'S UPONOR SAYS BUYS 40 PCT OF UNICOR.
newsitem.headline: ASKO'S UPONOR SAYS BUYS 40 PCT OF UNICOR.

text.p: Finnish furniture, plastic pipes and white goods maker Asko's Uponor pipes unit said on Wednesday it had bought 40 percent of German pipe group Unicor for an undisclosed sum.
"Unicor's net sales are almost 600 million markka, and the company has 780 employees," Asko's Uponor said in a statement.
Unicor makes composite pipes and systems for hot water applications in the building industry and for industrial markets, Uponor said.
Unicor's composite pipe products are based on its own patented technologies combining aluminium pipe with plastic layers, it said.
Unicor, based in Hassfurt, Germany, also makes drainage systems, cable protection pipes and machinery for the plastic pipe industry, it said.
